title: GENERAL CHEMISTRY FOR ENGINEERING APPLICATIONS
description: Introduces the structures, properties, and fundamental concepts in chemistry. Focuses on problem-solving with chemical concepts, developing an understanding of how processes and materials are used throughout all fields of engineering work. Topics include components of matter, atomic structure, chemical reactions, dimensional analysis, stoichiometry, light and the electromagnetic spectrum, chemical bonding, molecular shapes, thermochemistry, solutions, and gases. (Core Education course if taken with CH 204)
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 111Z*, 111*, 112Z*, 112*, 251Z*, 251HZ*, 251*, 251H*, 252Z*, 252HZ*, 252*, 252H*, 254*, 254H* or minimum score of 060 in 'Math Placement - ALEKS'.
* May be taken concurrently.
A minimum grade of D- is required in MTH 111Z, MTH 111, MTH 112Z, MTH 112, MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251, MTH 251H, MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252, MTH 252H, MTH 254 and MTH 254H.
